title: The Last Oath Again
author: Odile Okonkwo
blurb: Mirabel Oyelaran, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
